scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,marketing -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:apps:marketing"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd .. && npm run install:apps
scripts.install:apps: npm install && cd apps/marketing && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install && cd ../digix-admin && npm install && cd ../finance && npm install && cd ../fulfillment && npm install
scripts.test:api: cd backend && node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:5001', (r) => { console.log('API', r.statusCode); process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1); }).on('error', () => process.exit(1));"
